name: Hero Services
description: A warm split hero: a left column (kicker, big heading, sub, primary + ghost buttons, footer note) beside a right bento of four numbered service cards, each with a number, title, description, arrow chip, and a real photo.
interactions: on first view (IntersectionObserver adds .is-inview) the left column and the four cards fade up (wpmn-hs-up 600ms), the cards staggered 70/140/210ms
buttons shift background on hover; each card photo carries a warm warning-tint overlay
prefers-reduced-motion: content rendered in place, no animation
